title: G8 bucket-stratified recall (V1 one-off)
description: Per-bucket recall measurement of the surnames Bloom filter against the G8 synthetic corpus. V1 transparency-copy input replacing the 81.70 pt population-composition figure; ships point estimate + sample size only, no confidence-interval band. A later release may refine this.

version.description: Artifact version. A later release refines this metric.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: Recorded for uniformity; this builder is not randomized.

bloom_version_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the surnames.bloom RSBF file the recall was measured against.

buckets.description: Per-Census-bucket recall measurement. Keys match the demographic_bucket field on G8 corpus documents.

ci_band.description: V1 ships point estimate + sample size only. Always null in V1; a later release may populate this.

ci_band_note.description: Human-readable note explaining the V1 absence of a CI band.

recall_pts.description: Recall as a percentage (hits / sample_size * 100). Two-decimal precision is conventional but the schema does not constrain precision.

sample_size.description: Number of surname trials measured (one per name pii_span in the G8 corpus, restricted to documents tagged with this bucket).
